decisions.decision: Juggernaut jump arc raised from 50f to 120f
decisions.rationale: 50f was possibly too subtle on screen. 120f is ~12 tile heights, unmistakably visible.

decisions.decision: MovementComponent.jumpArcHeight applies to all units EXCEPT juggernaut effectively
decisions.rationale: Juggernaut never gets blue movement markers (showRangeMarkers skips floodFill for it). Its jump visual is AnimationComponent.JUMP in resolveJumperAttack, not MovementComponent. The jumpArcHeight field is for other units that move normally.

decisions.decision: Economy methods kept as public delegates on GameScreen
decisions.rationale: Zero call-site changes. Logic in StructureEconomySystem, GameScreen thin-delegates.
